answer: Aging-weighted reputation with costly re-entry: each agent's standing grows with verified participation over a rolling horizon and decays sharply if the account goes dormant. Sybil clones must start from an ember of trust, paying full compute and time costs to rebuild history while the original keeps its lead. An attacker's parallel identities stay onyx-dark to counterparties and earn nothing until each independently clears the same waiting period, making N clones cost N months plus N times the base infrastructure outlay.
